summary: 北美黑足鼬依赖草原犬鼠作为食物和洞穴来源，草原开垦及对犬鼠的清除曾使它一度被视为灭绝。重新发现残存个体后，人工繁育和野外重引入为种群恢复带来希望。

paragraphs.brief: 一度被认为消失的黑足鼬
sentences: The black-footed ferret (Mustela nigripes) is a small carnivorous mammal, similar in length to a domestic cat, and is the only ferret species native to North America.
黑足鼬是小型食肉哺乳动物，身长与家猫相仿，是北美唯一的原生雪貂类。
For at least 100,000 years they lived in an area that extended almost uninterrupted from southern Canada to northern Mexico.
至少十万年来，它们的分布区几乎连成一片，从加拿大南部延伸到墨西哥北部。
But numbers fell dramatically throughout the 19th and 20th centuries, to such an extent that the black-footed ferret was declared ‘possibly extinct’.
十九至二十世纪种群数量骤降，以至于黑足鼬被宣布“可能已经灭绝”。
Then, almost miraculously, it returned from the dead.
随后，人们又近乎奇迹般地重新发现了它。
paragraphs.gist: 黑足鼬是北美唯一的原生雪貂类，原先从加拿大南部到墨西哥北部广泛分布，后来数量骤减，一度被认为可能已经灭绝。

paragraphs.brief: 三种现生近亲的栖息差异
sentences: Within the genus Mustela, the ferret belongs to the subgenus Putorius, of which there are only three extant species: the European polecat; the Siberian polecat; and the black-footed ferret.
黑足鼬属于鼬属的艾鼬亚属，该亚属仅有三个现生种：欧洲艾鼬、西伯利亚艾鼬和黑足鼬。
The European polecat lives in open forests and meadows, and is thought to be the ancestor of the domestic ferret.
欧洲艾鼬生活在开阔的林地和草甸，一般认为是家养雪貂的祖先。
The Siberian polecat looks more similar to the black-footed ferret, and leads a similar life on open grasslands and semi-desert regions across Russia, China and Siberia.
西伯利亚艾鼬外形更像黑足鼬，也同样在开阔草地和半荒漠生活，分布于俄罗斯、中国和西伯利亚等地。
paragraphs.gist: 黑足鼬所属的亚属只有三个现生种，欧洲艾鼬可能是家养雪貂的祖先，而西伯利亚艾鼬在外貌和开放草原习性上更像黑足鼬。

paragraphs.brief: 迁入北美与草原犬鼠洞穴
sentences: Ferrets probably evolved in Europe between three and four million years ago, and dispersed into North America across an ice-age land bridge at least two million years ago.
雪貂类可能在三四百万年前演化于欧洲，至少两百万年前已经通过冰期陆桥进入北美。
They then advanced south-eastward to the Great Plains through ice-free passageways.
随后，它们沿无冰通道朝东南扩散至北美大平原。
The black-footed ferret’s history in North America is inextricably linked to the creature which became almost its sole prey — the prairie dog.
黑足鼬在北美的历史与几乎成为其唯一猎物的草原犬鼠密不可分。
These small rodents are a type of ground squirrel which live in networks of underground tunnels, known as burrows.
草原犬鼠是小型地栖啮齿动物，属于地松鼠类，住在成网的地下洞道中。
The black-footed ferret’s short legs and long, slim body make it superbly adapted for life in the burrow systems of its prey.
黑足鼬腿短、身体细长，非常适合在猎物的洞道中活动。
paragraphs.gist: 雪貂类可能从欧洲经冰期大陆桥到达北美，黑足鼬后来以草原犬鼠为主要猎物，短腿和细长身体恰好便于进入犬鼠洞道。

paragraphs.brief: 难以见到的标本与早期确认
sentences: Spending virtually all their time underground, black-footed ferrets have always been elusive.
黑足鼬几乎整天待在地下，一直很难被人看见。
Ferrets are never mentioned in accounts of the early explorers or pioneers who crossed the Great Plains by wagon train during the early to mid-1800s.
十九世纪初至中叶乘马车队穿越大平原的探险者和先驱者，在记录中从未提到黑足鼬。
They were, however, occasionally listed in records kept by fur companies in the upper Missouri River basin during that period.
不过，同时期密苏里河上游的毛皮公司偶尔留下过它的登记。

Black-footed ferrets were not officially recognized by scientists until 1851, when a description and drawing of one featured in a book by the renowned naturalist John James Audubon and Reverend John Bachman.
直到1851年，博物学家约翰·詹姆斯·奥杜邦与约翰·巴克曼牧师的书中出现这种动物的描述和绘图，它才获科学界正式承认。
For over two decades, no other specimens were seen, and scientists even began to question their existence.
此后二十多年都未见其他标本，科学家甚至开始怀疑它是否存在。
Then, in 1874, a Dr Elliott Coues issued a request for specimens through the popular magazine The American Sportsman, and was soon rewarded.
1874年，埃利奥特·库斯博士在大众杂志《美国运动员》公开征集标本，很快就有所收获。
With these he was able to add to Audubon’s description, and confirm the existence of the black-footed ferret.
他由此补充了奥杜邦的描述，证实黑足鼬确实存在。
paragraphs.gist: 黑足鼬常年藏在地下，早期旅行记录几乎没有记载，直到1851年出现正式描述，后来又靠公开征集的标本才再次确认它的存在。

paragraphs.brief: 农牧业扩张摧毁主要猎物
sentences: In the decades that followed, European settlement across North America changed the landscape dramatically, with vast areas being transformed into crop and grazing land.
随后几十年，欧洲移民在北美各地落脚，大面积土地变成耕地和牧场，地貌大为改变。
As agriculture and ranching expanded, the black-footed ferret’s main prey, the prairie dog, became a target for extermination, and was eventually eradicated from 98% of its original range.
随着农业和畜牧业扩张，黑足鼬的主要猎物草原犬鼠成为灭除对象，最终在原有分布区百分之九十八的面积上被消灭。
The result was devastating for black-footed ferret populations throughout the continent.
这对整个北美大陆的黑足鼬种群造成了毁灭性影响。

Even today, the prairie dog is still trapped and poisoned, because ranchers believe that it competes with livestock for grass — a notion that belies recent research showing that prairie dogs and cattle feed on different plants.
时至今日，人们仍捕捉和毒杀草原犬鼠，因为牧场主认为它会与牲畜争草；然而近期研究显示，犬鼠和牛吃的其实是不同的植物。
paragraphs.gist: 农业和牧场扩张使草原犬鼠在原有分布区的百分之九十八遭清除，黑足鼬随之丧失主要食源，而牛与犬鼠争食的说法又与新研究相悖。

sentences: As late as the 1950s, black-footed ferrets were still thought to occur in low densities throughout most of their historic range.
迟至二十世纪五十年代，人们仍认为黑足鼬虽密度不高，却分布在大部分历史栖息地。
However, by the 1960s, the only known population was a small colony in south-western South Dakota.
但到六十年代，人们仅知道南达科他州西南部还剩一个小种群。
In 1967, the US Fish and Wildlife Service classified the black-footed ferret as an endangered species, and in 1974 the South Dakota colony disappeared.
1967年，美国鱼类及野生动物管理局将黑足鼬列为濒危物种，1974年南达科他州的种群消失。
Finally, in January 1979, the last ferret in a captive-breeding programme died — making the black-footed ferret the first mammal to be declared extinct in the Northern Hemisphere in the 20th century.
1979年1月，圈养繁育计划中的最后一只也死去，黑足鼬遂成为二十世纪北半球第一种被宣布灭绝的哺乳动物。
paragraphs.gist: 美国最后已知的野生群落于1974年消失，1979年圈养繁育计划中最后一只也死亡，黑足鼬于是被宣布灭绝。

paragraphs.brief: 农场犬的发现与圈养繁殖
sentences: But that was not the end of the story.
但故事的结局并非如此。
In 1981, a farm dog called Shep carried an odd-looking creature to its owner’s ranch house in Meeteetse, Wyoming.
1981年，怀俄明州米蒂齐一只叫谢普的农场犬把一只相貌奇特的动物叼回了主人家。
The rancher put the carcass in his fridge and alerted state officials.
牧场主把尸体放入冰箱，并通知州政府人员。
The dog had found a black-footed ferret — which led to efforts again being made to save the species.
那条狗找到的原来是黑足鼬，抢救这个物种的工作于是重新启动。
An intensive search in the region led to the discovery of a 130-strong population.
研究者在当地全面搜寻，发现一个约有一百三十只的野生种群。
This wild colony thrived for a while, but disaster struck again and the number of animals was drastically reduced by the disease distemper — probably contracted from domestic dogs.
这个种群一度繁盛，后来却因犬瘟热而骤减，这种病很可能由家犬传来。
In 1985, in a final bid to save the species, the remaining 18 individuals in the colony were trapped for a new captive-breeding programme.
1985年，为了挽救物种，人们捕获该群剩下的十八只黑足鼬，开始新的圈养繁育计划。
This project was successful, and there are now more than 2,000 black-footed ferrets in captivity across the US and Canada.
计划取得成功，美加两国圈养的黑足鼬已超过两千只。
paragraphs.gist: 怀俄明州一条农场犬的发现引出约一百三十只野生黑足鼬，犬瘟热暴发后仅存十八只被捕入繁育计划，最终重建了圈养种群。

paragraphs.brief: 放归前训练捕猎和入洞
sentences: A reintroduction programme began in 1991.
1991年，放归计划启动。
Before they can be reintroduced into their natural habitat, captive ferrets have to learn to hunt and escape from predators.
圈养的黑足鼬在回归自然栖息地前，得先学会捕猎以及躲避捕食者。
They are first held in pens on the prairie, where they are fed prairie dog meat.
它们先被养在草原上的围栏里，由饲养员喂食草原犬鼠肉。
Once the ferrets associate these animals with food, keepers unleash live prey into the pens, and they soon realise that they must hunt or go hungry.
它们把犬鼠与食物联系起来后，饲养员再把活的猎物放入围栏，黑足鼬很快就明白不捕猎就得挨饿。
Then, to get the ferrets used to living underground, they have to be tempted into the holes with food.
接着，饲养员用食物引它们进入洞穴，让它们习惯地下生活。
paragraphs.gist: 放归前必须让圈养黑足鼬学会捕猎、躲避天敌和入洞生活，饲养者先喂犬鼠肉，再放入活猎物并用食物引它们进入洞穴。

paragraphs.brief: 哈诺斯草原的恢复机会
sentences: Reintroduction programmes are now underway across central USA, but there is one location that is key.
美国中部多地正在实施放归计划，其中有一个地点尤其关键。

The Janos area on the US-Mexico border is the obvious place to reactivate the continent’s wild black-footed ferret population, being one of the most important remaining grassland ecosystems in the Americas, and home to an abundance of prairie dogs.
美墨边界的哈诺斯地区是恢复北美野生黑足鼬种群的理想地点。那里保存着美洲重要的草原生态系统之一，也有充足的草原犬鼠。
At the last report, the future of the black-footed ferret finally looks promising.
据最近的报告，黑足鼬的前景终于显得有希望。
paragraphs.gist: 美墨边界的哈诺斯保存了广阔草原和丰富的草原犬鼠，是恢复大陆野生黑足鼬种群的重要放归地点。

items.en: reasons for the sharp decrease in black-footed ferret populations
items.zh: 黑足鼬数量急剧下降的原因。
items.why: 农业和牧场开发破坏了黑足鼬的栖息地；人们又大量消灭草原犬鼠，使黑足鼬失去了主要食物。

items.en: the procedure by which black-footed ferrets are taught to survive in the wild
items.zh: 训练黑足鼬在野外生存的步骤。
items.why: 题干中的 procedure 对应这一段的训练步骤: 先认识食物，再捕猎活物，再适应地下洞穴生活。因此答案是 H。

items.en: mention of doubts about whether there was such an animal as a black-footed ferret
items.zh: 提到有人怀疑黑足鼬这种动物是否真的存在。
items.why: 二十多年没有再找到黑足鼬标本，科学家甚至开始怀疑这种动物是否存在。

items.en: reference to a site which is ideal for the release of black-footed ferrets into the wild
items.zh: 提到一处适合将黑足鼬放归野外的地点。
items.why: 这一地点是重要的草原生态系统，又有大量草原犬鼠可供捕食，因此被认为适合重建野生黑足鼬种群。

items.en: The black-footed ferret shares most characteristics with its relative, the ________.
items.zh: 黑足鼬的大部分特征与其近亲________相同。
items.why: 原文从外形和生活方式两方面比较黑足鼬及其近亲，最相似的是西伯利亚艾鼬。

items.en: North American ferrets are thought to have originally come from ________.
items.zh: 人们认为，北美的黑足鼬原本来自________。
items.why: 题干中的 originally come from 对应原文的 evolved in Europe。注意这里问的是“北美的 ferrets最初来自哪里”,答案是地点 Europe。

items.en: The ________ is the black-footed ferret’s primary source of food.
items.why: 定位句说：“黑足鼬在北美的历史与几乎成为其唯一猎物的草原犬鼠密不可分。”

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空最多填两个词。

items.en: An appeal for evidence of black-footed ferrets was published.
items.zh: 人们公开征求能证明黑足鼬存在的证据。

items.en: A scheme for releasing captive-born black-footed ferrets into the wild was launched.
items.zh: 一项将人工繁育的黑足鼬放归野外的计划启动了。

items.en: The black-footed ferret first appeared in a scientific work.
items.zh: 科学著作中第一次出现了对黑足鼬的记载。

items.en: The discovery of a single black-footed ferret led to renewed hope for the species.
items.zh: 一只黑足鼬被发现，使人们重新看到了这个物种延续下去的希望。

items.en: North America’s last wild-born black-footed ferrets were taken into captivity.
items.zh: 北美最后一批在野外出生的黑足鼬被带走，转为人工圈养。

items.en: Efforts to save the black-footed ferret were officially announced as having failed.
items.zh: 官方宣布，拯救黑足鼬的努力已经失败。

pairs: shares most characteristics with its relative
与其近亲的外形更相似
主要食物来源／几乎唯一的猎物
征集证据，在文中是请求提供标本
把圈养繁殖的动物放归自然的计划
doubts about whether there was such an animal
怀疑这种动物是否存在
points: 农业和牧场开发破坏了黑足鼬的栖息地；人们又大量消灭草原犬鼠，使黑足鼬失去了主要食物。
定位句说：“黑足鼬在北美的历史与几乎成为其唯一猎物的草原犬鼠密不可分。”
clauses: Even today, the prairie dog is still trapped and poisoned, … — a notion that belies recent research showing that prairie dogs and cattle feed on different plants.
连接词 because 引出“because ranchers believe that it competes with livestock for grass”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
The dog had found a black-footed ferret — ….
“which led to efforts again being made to save the species”修饰前面的 ferret。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 ferret，再把修饰信息接回主句。

北美最稀有的哺乳动物之一的上升、下降和上升
